In detail

Grouped with Dębniki and Łagiewniki-Borek Fałęcki in the 2024 police district breakdown (235 property thefts, 17 vehicle thefts, 20 burglaries, 10 robberies, 36 bodily injuries, 8 fights across the three combined — a moderate, mid-table result). The 2020 Otodom survey rated it 3.64/5 individually, a middling score. No specific 2025-2026 incident coverage was found for this district beyond these figures. Sources checked: Kraków Nasze Miasto (2024 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
